scope: New intruder control-panel and shared-keypad picture families. Real manufacturer photographs and original manufacturer manual graphics only.
method: Compared proposed identifiers and visual families with all 396 existing FINDR picture records.
Verified existing archive record identifiers against catalogue.json. No new archive entries invented.
Visually inspected original PDF pages and manufacturer photographs, then inspected final crops in a contact sheet.
Preserved shared-keypad limitations and grouped finish variants; source pictures do not imply complete emulator coverage.
Retained PDFs in work/ as research inputs only. Only reviewed raster assets are in images/.
limitations: Photographs establish a source-correct visual reference, not the installed main-panel model, PCB revision, software menu version or product availability.
Menvier M800iD picture coverage must not broaden the existing M750/M800 emulator claim.
New HKC, Acre and Pyronix models with no exact bundled archive match intentionally have empty record_ids.
Paradox manual families remain outside UK priority because UK availability evidence was not established.
The manufacturer currently photographs EURO 76 L and SW-10270-T with their cabinets open; notes identify this explicitly.
